notes: Duration: DAAD page states 'Programme duration 7 semesters' (= 3.5 years). Teaching languages: the programme is taught in English in the first two semesters and partly in German in higher semesters; German A2 required by the third semester (quoted). Tuition: the 500 EUR per semester figure is given on the DAAD page as applying to non-EU/UK/CH applicants for THIS programme; note it is labelled 'tuition fees' on that page and separately as a 'DIT service fee' on the THD pages — audited as the fee a Moroccan (non-EU) student pays. Intakes: no training start date or application-opens date is given for this programme; the pages only state the application period 15 October – 15 December for the summer semester, so no ISO date could be quoted and the single intake object carries all-null dates — the application window (15 Oct – 15 Dec) is the key information. applicationChannel: the DAAD page only says 'Submit application via Please check this website'; the THD application page says international applicants apply directly via the university's own portal Primuss, so de-university-direct is used (no uni-assist/VPD is mentioned anywhere). Language test list on the DAAD page also names TOEIC, telc and PTE Academic, which are not in the acceptedTests vocabulary. Grade thresholds: 'None of our programmes requests specific GPAs' — no threshold stated.

note.fr: Un diplôme d'accès à l'enseignement supérieur (Hochschulzugangsberechtigung) est exigé. Un diplôme étranger doit être reconnu comme équivalent ; vérifiez votre admissibilité via la base de données du DAAD ou Anabin, et une année d'études ou un Studienkolleg peut être requise.
note.en: A university entrance qualification (Hochschulzugangsberechtigung) is required. A foreign certificate must be recognised as equivalent; check your eligibility via the DAAD database or Anabin, and one year of study or a Studienkolleg may be required.

note.fr: Pour la phase principale du programme, un contrat de travail avec une entreprise partenaire est une condition obligatoire et un stage en hôtellerie est requis ; les deux premières années se font à distance.
note.en: For the main study phase, an employment contract with a practical partner is a mandatory requirement and a hotel industry placement is needed; the first two semesters are online.

evidence.quote: Having an employment contract with a practical partner is a mandatory requirement for transferring to the main phase of the study programme.

note.fr: Des frais s'appliquent : 60 EUR de frais de candidature et 500 EUR de frais de service par semestre pour les candidats non-UE/EEE, ainsi qu'un montant pour l'association étudiante.
note.en: Fees apply: a 60 EUR application fee and a 500 EUR service fee per semester for non-EU/EEA applicants, plus a student union fee.

evidence.quote: €60 application fee (multiple applications possible without further payment) at the Deggendorf Institute of Technology, plus €500 DIT service fee per semester for enrolled students (the academic year consists of two semesters)
